name: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 15AMN8 (82XQ01S3IN)
description: A practical everyday laptop for college coursework, online classes, coding practice and document work. The Ryzen 3 7320U processor and 8GB LPDDR5 memory handle common student workloads, while the 512GB NVMe SSD keeps boot times and file access responsive. Its 15.6-inch Full HD anti-glare screen gives room for split-screen notes and research. This configuration has soldered memory, so choose the RAM capacity carefully before purchase.

name: HP 15s (15-fc0029AU, Ryzen 5)
description: A thin-and-light 15.6-inch laptop suited to assignments, browsing, video lectures, spreadsheets and beginner programming. The AMD Ryzen 5 7520U processor is paired with 8GB LPDDR5 memory and a 512GB SSD. The Full HD anti-glare panel is comfortable for everyday study, and Windows 11 with Microsoft Office support makes it useful for common college tasks. Check the exact SKU and RAM configuration on the seller page before ordering.

name: Samsung Galaxy Tab A9 Wi-Fi (4GB/64GB, SM-X110)
description: A compact Android tablet for reading PDFs, attending online classes, watching recorded lectures and taking notes with a compatible third-party stylus. The 8.7-inch display is easy to carry between classrooms and hostel rooms. Its expandable storage is useful for keeping lecture videos and study files offline. This is the Wi-Fi 4GB/64GB configuration; verify the model code because LTE and memory variants are sold separately.

name: Samsung Galaxy Tab S9 FE Wi-Fi (6GB/128GB)
description: A more capable study tablet for handwritten notes, PDF annotation, presentations and multitasking. The included S Pen makes it suitable for marking lecture slides and sketching diagrams without buying a separate stylus. Its 10.9-inch 90Hz display, Exynos processor and IP68-rated design make it a versatile option for students who want a tablet for both study and entertainment. Confirm whether the listing is Wi-Fi or 5G and check the RAM/storage variant.

name: Samsung Galaxy M36 5G (6GB/128GB)
description: A 5G smartphone for students who need a daily device for calls, learning apps, document scanning, video lectures and photography. It combines a 6.7-inch Full HD+ Super AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate and an Exynos 1380 processor. Samsung lists a 50MP main camera with OIS, a 5000mAh battery and long-term Android/security update support. Charger is sold separately on many retail packages.

name: Sony WH-CH520 Wireless On-Ear Headphones
description: Lightweight wireless on-ear headphones for recorded lectures, online meetings, music and focused study sessions. Sony specifies up to 50 hours of battery life, USB-C charging and multipoint connection so the headphones can switch between two paired devices. The built-in microphone supports calls, while the compact swivel design makes them easy to carry in a backpack.

name: boAt Rockerz 430 Wireless Headphones
description: An affordable over-ear wireless headset for students who listen to lectures, attend online classes and want music playback between study sessions. The Rockerz 430 listing highlights 40mm audio drivers, BEAST Mode and up to 40 hours of playback. The cushioned earcups and adjustable headband are intended for everyday use. Check the exact colour and current bundle on the official boAt listing.

name: Logitech MK270R Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo
description: A full-size wireless keyboard and mouse set for students who work at a desk, write reports or use a laptop with an external monitor. Both devices connect through one compact 2.4GHz USB receiver, reducing cable clutter. The keyboard includes a numeric keypad and dedicated media keys, while the mouse is compact for everyday navigation. Confirm the regional keyboard layout before ordering.

name: Logitech M220 Silent Wireless Mouse
description: A compact, quiet wireless mouse for library desks, shared hostel rooms and everyday laptop use. Logitech's SilentTouch technology reduces clicking noise, and the symmetrical shape works for left- and right-handed users. It uses a small USB nano receiver and an optical sensor for reliable cursor movement. A single AA battery can last up to 18 months under Logitech's stated usage conditions.

name: Casio FX-991EX ClassWiz Scientific Calculator
description: A non-programmable scientific calculator designed for engineering, science and mathematics coursework. Its ClassWiz interface supports advanced calculations including matrices, vectors, complex numbers, statistics and spreadsheet-style calculations. The high-resolution natural textbook display helps show expressions in a familiar format. Always check your university or examination rules before purchasing a calculator model.

name: Ambrane Stylo N20 20,000mAh Power Bank
description: A high-capacity power bank for students who spend long hours on campus, travel between home and college or need backup power during outages. The 20,000mAh battery is designed to recharge phones and other USB-powered devices, with USB Type-C input/output and USB-A output ports. LED indicators show the remaining charge. Check the exact output wattage and included cable on the selected variant.

name: Philips HD9306/06 1.5L Electric Kettle
description: A stainless-steel electric kettle for boiling water in a hostel or shared accommodation. The 1.5-litre capacity is useful for preparing tea, coffee and instant meals where permitted by hostel rules. It has an automatic shut-off function and a cordless 360-degree base for convenient lifting and pouring. Check whether your hostel allows personal heating appliances before purchase.

name: Milton Fame Thermosteel Bottle (1000ml)
description: A reusable insulated bottle for carrying water, tea or coffee to lectures, labs and the library. The double-wall vacuum construction helps retain beverage temperature, while the screw-top lid is designed to be leak-resistant for everyday carrying. The 1-litre size offers a useful balance between capacity and portability. Hand washing is recommended by the manufacturer.

name: Safari Omega 30L Laptop Backpack with Rain Cover
description: A practical college backpack for carrying notebooks, a laptop, charger, water bottle and daily essentials. The Omega model is listed with a 30-litre capacity, multiple compartments and a rain cover, helping students separate books and accessories during commutes. Padded shoulder straps support everyday carrying. Check the internal laptop sleeve dimensions against your laptop before ordering.

name: Wildcraft Hopper Laptop Backpack
description: A branded everyday backpack for students who carry a laptop, books and accessories between home, hostel and campus. The Hopper design uses a main storage compartment, front utility pocket and padded shoulder straps. Its compact profile is suitable for daily commuting. Confirm laptop sleeve size, capacity and current colour availability on Wildcraft's product page.

name: Wipro Garnet 6W LED Study Table Lamp
description: A compact LED desk lamp for reading textbooks, writing notes and working at a study table. The Garnet model shown is rated at 6W and has a flexible neck so the light can be directed toward the page. The listing describes touch control and multiple brightness levels. It is a useful low-power desk light for hostel rooms and small study spaces.

name: Portronics Power Plate Plus 6-in-1 Power Extender
description: A compact power extender for a study desk with multiple devices such as a laptop adapter, phone charger and tablet charger. The Power Plate Plus product page describes three universal AC sockets, USB charging ports and individual illuminated switches. Child-safety shutters are provided on the sockets. Check the rated wattage and socket/USB combination on the product page before connecting high-power appliances.

name: SanDisk Ultra Flair 128GB USB 3.0 Flash Drive
description: A portable USB flash drive for moving lecture slides, project files, presentations and documents between computers. The Ultra Flair range uses a metal casing and USB 3.0 interface, with manufacturer-rated read speeds up to 150MB/s on supported devices. Actual transfer speed depends on the host port and file sizes. Keep a second backup of important academic work rather than relying on one pen drive.

name: HP DeskJet Ink Advantage 2335 All-in-One Printer
description: An entry-level all-in-one inkjet printer for students who regularly print assignments, forms and project reports. It combines printing, scanning and copying in one compact unit and connects to a computer through USB. HP's published specifications list print speeds up to 7.5 pages per minute in black and 5.5 pages per minute in colour under standard test conditions. Ink costs and cartridge availability should be considered before purchase.

name: Portronics Modesk 200 Adjustable Mobile Stand
description: A foldable desktop phone stand for keeping a smartphone upright during online lectures, video calls and study timers. The Modesk 200 has an adjustable viewing angle and a compact fold-flat design, making it easy to keep in a pencil case or laptop bag. Its non-slip contact points help hold a phone steady on a desk. The listing specifies compatibility with phones up to approximately 7 inches.
